tools.name: fix_page_seo
tools.description: Runs the SEO Records correction engine (the one inside the SEO Records module) on a public page and returns every correction it would apply: the value, the source it comes from, and the exact HTML tag to add or replace in <head> — title, meta description, canonical URL, hreflang, Open Graph and Twit

tools.name: get_automatic_fix_offer
tools.description: Returns the SEO Records products that apply these corrections automatically on every page: the SEO Records module (WordPress, PrestaShop, Joomla, Drupal, custom PHP; from €199/year) and SEO Outpost (the same corrections at the network edge, any hosting; from €199 for a year), with what each does, pr

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fix_page_seo" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
